glosses: A conclusive success following an effort, conflict, or confrontation of obstacles; victory; conquest.

examples.text: After being defeated in three previous finals, Roger finally tasted triumph at this year's competition.

glosses: A magnificent and imposing ceremonial performed in honor of a victor.
Any triumphal procession; a pompous exhibition; a stately show or pageant.
